notes: Ending rung of ladders\Stray.json: the harness installs a copy of the user's Slot_1 as slot 3 (ZoneName 07_Ending/Ending_ZONE, OBJ_ControlRoom_04 in progress: the roof is already open). 게임 시작 > slot 3 > 계속 > loading (~6 s, black, no loading screen; the cat lies on the floor by the control room window) > Esc: the pause menu is the loaded marker > the recorded walk (~3.5 min): through the CONTROL ROOM airlock (two striped doors, the second opens ~10 s after the first closes) > the lobby > the big red door at the end of the hall (it opens as the cat comes) > the tunnel behind it (W into the moss-covered boxes, which aligns the cat) > up the first flight to its top step > the second flight, up into the light > the overgrown path > the outdoor stairs > fade, the final cutscene (~20 s) > the credits (~3 min, not skippable: Esc/Enter/Space tapped or held do nothing) > the game returns to the main menu by itself > 나가기 > 예. The camera follows the mouse (look:dx,dy) and W walks where it looks, so each leg turns roughly (a fixed look) and then in small steps until a checkpoint of the target view matches (airlock_door, red_door, tunnel_stairs, exit_top / exit_far: scenery, never the cat); the legs then end against a wall or an object, which keeps the route repeatable. From the landing on, the game's own letterboxed camera takes over: the last legs are fixed key holds recorded 2026-10-03 (W, back, left, W, right, W). Recorded and replayed on a warm cache, 1280x720 Mopic capture of the merged lenticular view. The ending does not change slot 3 (save-after unchanged), so Continue lands at the same place every time. The pause menu sometimes opens by itself (seen twice, after 15-20 min, once with UEVR's 'spoofed gamepad connection' in log.txt): the steps press Esc when pause_menu shows between legs. Timing: boot ~60 s + menus ~25 + load 20 + walk ~210 + exit ~60 + cutscene and credits ~200 + quit ~20: ~10 min, inside run-test.ps1's 900 s. Keys: W/A/S/D walk, mouse camera; Esc pause. Dialogs (orange band) default to 아니요; 예 is right of it. Status 2026-10-03: not repeatable yet. 1 PASS through run-test.ps1, then 3 ladder MENU_FAILs at different legs (red door: fixed; exit alignment: reworked, matched in a replay; the climb stopping short of the top step), and two replays of the fixed legs after the exit ended in the plants at the top of the second flight (ladders\Stray.json, the ending rung's status). Testing a leg without a restart: pause > 마지막 체크포인트 다시 불러오기 > 예 puts the cat back at the Continue spawn (same view as after Continue), then gamepilot run --steps 22-80.

steps.note: slot 3 is the test slot the harness installed the rung's save into; slot 1 (the user's Control Room save) and slot 2 are never opened
the submenu (계속 / 챕터 선택 / 지우기) opens under the selected card: slot3_continue_selected only matches under slot 3
loaded marker: Esc opens the pause menu (재개 preselected), Esc again resumes
the recorded route: fixed holds from the Continue spawn (cat lying by the window); camera pitched down first
turn right in small steps until the striped CONTROL ROOM airlock door is centered (the walk so far leaves it 100-200 px right of center after look:-260)
the airlock: door 2 opens only some seconds after the cat is inside (door 1 closes first)

turn right in small steps until the big red door at the end of the hall (left of the slanted pillar) is in the middle. red_door is the door's left half (its blue sign panel, 90x70 px): the whole door (170x108, until 2026-10-03) changed with the cat's distance after the airlock (one run stopped about 5% further back: best score 0.82, missed)
turn right in small steps until the middle of the staircase (between its handrails) is ahead; aimed further left the cat climbs the planter beside it
up the first flight; 6 s of W stop on its top step, before the landing's cinematic camera takes over (walking on, W goes wherever that camera looks)
the way out (the second flight, up into the light, under the row of old monitors) is to the left: turn left in small steps until it is ahead

the camera after the climb varies: its pitch (one run looked up at the ceiling with the cat out of view: exit_top at margin 16 never matched) and its distance to the cat (the handrail and the wall push it in). The pitch is pushed to its top stop, then down a fixed 900 (repeatable within ~20 px for one camera distance; around 1000 the camera meets the floor and the view jumps). Then turn left until either exit view matches: exit_top (the old one, margin 48 for the vertical spread: 0.82-0.88 over ~55 units of yaw in a replay from the checkpoint, 0.95 on the run it was recorded on) or exit_far (the monitor row from a camera close to the cat, 0.99 there; exit_top reaches only 0.35 at that distance). wait_for with a list stands in for a seek over two checkpoints (a look press after each failed check, about one a second)

recorded 2026-10-03 (each W ends against something, which keeps the route repeatable): W to the foot of the second flight (the cat stops right of its middle handrail) > back, left > W up the flight (stops in the plants at the top left) > right > W out onto the overgrown path > W along it and up the outdoor stairs; the letterboxed camera there is the game's, W follows it

the final cutscene starts at the top of the outdoor stairs with a fade to black (~20 s of cutscene, W does not skip it), then the credits, white text on black. ending_black (the left edge of the Mopic capture pure black: only the fades and the credits, never the dark tunnel) stops the W presses

the cutscene and the credits take ~200 s from the first black frame (Esc, Enter, Space, tapped or held, do not skip them); the game returns to the main menu by itself, the proof that the ending played to its end
